integrity: The proof is symbolic and its exact-integer checks are corroboration rather than a substitute for proof. Prior ordinary Frobenius results are acknowledged and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only p=1 and the two stated offset patterns for k>=1; no claims for arbitrary prime tuples or p>=2; possible unindexed equivalent work. Computation is finite corroboration, not the basis of the infinite proof.
title: First generalized Frobenius numbers of both prime-triplet-shaped families
